date_note: First precisely day-dated foundational source is the initial arXiv posting of 2010-01-27; the classical Klein 1879 work has no asserted exact first-public day.
integrity: The proof derives the infinite odd-degree claim, with exact independent code checks of the finite normal-basis and isometry calculations. The classical cubic model, geometric Fermat phenomenon, and five rational lines are prior work. No independent expert audit has been performed.
limitations: Only odd extension degrees are classified; not a claim about birational selfmaps or complete geometric automorphism group. Historical priority is provisional, especially with respect to possible general finite-field form/twist classifications.
title: Odd-degree arithmetic automorphism groups of the characteristic-two Klein cubic
